# calibration

`measure.cpp`, `normalize.cpp`, `profile.cpp`, `store.cpp`, and `validate.cpp` implement gamepad calibration measurement, normalization, profile construction, persistence, and validation through the `stick_measurer`, `motion_bias_measurer`, `apply`, `profile`, `store`, and `validate` APIs.

## Contents

### Measurement

- [measure.cpp](./measure.cpp) implements `stick_measurer` rest/sweep accumulation and `motion_bias_measurer` bias averaging.
- [measure.hpp](./measure.hpp) declares `stick_measurer` and `motion_bias_measurer`, including observation, finalization, reset, and sample-count APIs.

### Normalization

- [normalize.cpp](./normalize.cpp) implements `apply` for calibrated sticks, triggers, and motion samples.
- [normalize.hpp](./normalize.hpp) declares allocation-free `apply(const profile&, const raw_sample&, canonical_sample&) noexcept`.

### Profiles

- [profile.cpp](./profile.cpp) implements `to_string(value_source)` and `default_profile(controller::family)`.
- [profile.hpp](./profile.hpp) defines `value_source`, `stick_calibration`, `trigger_calibration`, `motion_calibration`, and `profile`.

### Persistence

- [store.cpp](./store.cpp) implements deterministic `.cal` serialization, parsing, validation, and device-identity checks through `store::save` and `store::load`.
- [store.hpp](./store.hpp) declares `store`, `store::file_for`, `store::save`, `store::load`, and `store::directory`.

### Validation

- [validate.cpp](./validate.cpp) implements `validate(const profile&, string&) noexcept` for profile version, finiteness, range, threshold, and smoothing checks.
- [validate.hpp](./validate.hpp) declares the public `validate` contract.

## Architecture / Data Flow

`stick_measurer::observe_rest` and `stick_measurer::observe_sweep` accumulate raw stick samples before `stick_measurer::finalize` creates `stick_calibration`.

`motion_bias_measurer::observe` accumulates `motion_sample` components before `motion_bias_measurer::finalize` writes `motion_calibration` bias values.

`default_profile` creates built-in `profile` data, `validate` checks profile invariants, `store::save` serializes validated profiles, `store::load` parses and validates persisted profiles, and `apply` transforms `raw_sample` data into `canonical_sample` data.

## Behavioral Contracts

- `stick_measurer::finalize` uses `constexpr float min_range {0.1f}`.
- `stick_measurer::finalize` uses `std::max(max_x_, min_range)` and `std::max(max_y_, min_range)` for swept ranges.
- `stick_measurer::finalize` uses `1.0f` for unswept ranges, `0.0f` for missing rest centers, and `0.0f` for `drift_threshold`.
- `motion_bias_measurer::finalize` computes means with `1.0 / static_cast<double>(n_)`.
- `apply` clamps stick coordinates to `[-1.0f, 1.0f]` and trigger values to `[0.0f, 1.0f]`.
- `apply` radial-normalizes stick magnitudes above `1.0f` and snaps magnitudes `<= c.drift_threshold` to `{0.0f, 0.0f}`.
- `apply` falls back to the driver trigger value when `max - min <= 0.0f`.
- `store` uses the exact header token `"gamepad-controller-calibration"`.
- `store` uses `controller-<family>.cal` and `controller-<family>-<16-digit lowercase hex key>.cal` filenames.
- `store` writes `family`, `source`, `device_key`, `stick`, `trigger`, `motion`, and `smoothing` records.
- `store` uses stream precision `9` for float round trips.
- `validate` requires `1 <= profile::version <= profile::current_version`.
- `validate` requires finite calibration fields, positive stick ranges, `max > min` trigger ranges, `drift_threshold` in `[0, 1)`, and non-negative finite `profile::smoothing`.

## File Relationships

`profile` aggregates `stick_calibration`, `trigger_calibration`, and `motion_calibration`; `measure.cpp`, `normalize.cpp`, `store.cpp`, and `validate.cpp` consume those value types.

`store::save` calls `validate`, while `store::load` calls `validate` after parsing and compares `profile::family` and `profile::device_key` against requested identity values.

`apply` consumes `profile`, `raw_sample`, and calibration sample types, then writes calibrated stick, trigger, and motion fields into `canonical_sample`.
